container() claim verified in Page.class.js: a child mounts in the parent's regions entry, else the nearest ancestor's $pages, else app.$pages, so a page with navigation keeps it and a page without is replaced. The rule text is in design/navigation/readme.md and core/Page/readme.md (rewritten after the redirect).

Redirect step 1: deputy/roles at 1920 with the sidebar open. The sidebar's right edge is x=255; the columns row's left edge is x=256 (row 1360 wide, scrollLeft 4080 of 5440). Eight columns (Inbox, Requirements, Report, Session, Requirements, Decisions, Report, Session) each 680 wide; the first sits at row-x -3824 only because the row has scrolled to the newest two. So the first column does NOT slide under the sidebar: no offset bug, nothing to fix; it is scrolled out by the row following the newest column. At 400 the row is 400 wide, 8 columns, scrollLeft 2800: one column visible. Shots roles-1920-before.png and roles-400-before.png. What draws the columns: AISession/AISessionsPage.js:57 (initialize(){ this.columns(); }) on /framework/ai/sessions/, so every session, task and subtask under it is a column (column_host() in Page.class.js:671 returns the shallowest columnar ancestor). core/Task, AITask, core/Session never call columns().

decision.what: Previews plus detail views replace Miller columns as the default (the owner's call, 2026-10-23)
decision.chose: revert a0b091ab4 (even columns default; columns code exactly as before, columns() stays opt-in), remove the columns() call from AISessionsPage so a clicked row or card opens the child's own page in place of the list, and give an AITask with tasks inside a Tasks tab of preview cards (page.preview_card, one per direct child, linking to the child's url)
decision.alternatives: even columns by default (step 2, reverted): still splits the screen; also considered fixing only the offset, but there was no offset bug

decision.chose: remove the entry; a page that says takeover now gets what none gets; the paging lab keeps its own lab-only entry in imagine/paging/blocks.js so its dropdown and stage.js stay whole
decision.alternatives: keep takeover in core as a second name for none

findings.text: words.js:53 (new comment) and the `blocks.js` comment say takeover was retired "2026-10-24", but the redirect and every other date in this change say 2026-10-23; fix the date so the record agrees.

Page.class.js:672 (`column_host`) calls `page.columns()` as a side effect inside a lookup; it is safe because `columns()` only sets three fields and is repeatable (line 665), but a reader will not expect a "host" query to switch a page into columns mode.

Retiring `takeover` in core means `nav_of("takeover")` now falls back to `NAVIGATION[0]` (`none`), which is what the brief asked. The paging lab keeps its own copy (`imagine/paging/blocks.js:47`), a small second list of navigation words; acceptable because `stage.js:272` still runs it, but it is a second source to remember.

Redirect step 4 is met narrowly: `AITask.js` gains a "Tasks" tab of existing `preview_card`s linking to `TaskTree.url(n)`, and `AISessionsPage.js` drops `columns()` so a row replaces the list. Shots `roles-1920-after.png`, `roles-child-1920-after.png` and `sessions-1920-after.png` are present; the diff cannot show that the Back button returns to the list, so confirm that in a shot or smoke.

The requirement that the first column's left edge be measured against the sidebar (redirect step 1) leaves no trace in the diff: no offset fix and no `roles-1920-offset-fixed.png`. Check the task log for the two numbers; if they are not there, the offset-versus-idea question was never answered.
